lines.text: At noon the trail was soft slush, so Ben left his cleats in the car.
By three the sun was behind the ridge,
and that slush froze into ruts of ice on the way down.
In winter, plan for the trail you'll walk out on.
Roll your cleats into their bag and keep them in your pack.
Pull them on at the first shine of ice.
Save this before your next winter hike.
